**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

- **Searched:** Articles VI–IX (payments, royalties, covenants, manufacturing/supply) plus definitions for MFN markers — "most favored", "favorable", "best price", "terms at least as", third-party matching/first-refusal language.
- **Result:** No provision obliges Ono to give Array pricing or terms no less favourable than those granted to any third party, and nothing requires Ono to match a third-party offer. That is our preferred position (no MFN burden on the customer).
- **Comparable-terms language found runs in our favour:** Section 9.x(b) bars Array from requiring Ono to order from a Subcontractor unwilling to supply "on terms as favorable to Ono as the terms such Subcontractors have extended to Array." Per the rule, vendor-granted benefits are left untouched.
- **Noted, not flagged:** Section 8.2 exclusivity is a non-compete rather than an MFN and belongs to a different rule.
